description: This file contains the implementation of the S3StorageService class, an Amazon S3-based storage service implementing the StorageService interface for the OpenMRS project. It provides methods for retrieving, storing, checking existence, and deleting data stored in S3 buckets, with configuration options for credentials, region, and other S3 settings.

classes.name: S3StorageService
classes.description: A service class that interacts with Amazon S3 for storage operations, implemented as a Spring @Service component with configuration options for S3 credentials and settings.

methods.name: S3StorageService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the S3 client with configuration parameters such as credentials, region, endpoint, and bucket name.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves data as an InputStream from S3 given a key.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata such as content type and size for a given S3 object key.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Lists keys (objects) in S3 under a specific module or group with a prefix filter.

methods.name: purgeData
methods.description: Deletes a specific object from S3 if it exists.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an object exists in S3 for a given key.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Stores data into S3 with specified metadata and returns the generated key.
